purpose: Stage 0 of the I reserve: gate state and axial drive at every trough of the retained traces.
axial_convention: inward positive, sum((V_neighbour - V_soma) / R_axial) in nA

decision.decision: soma h 0.983 >= 0.7 at trough + 6 ms: availability is not the limit; the reserve tests post-trough drive

rule.statistic: median over unflagged cycles, smaller of the two inputs
